subject.title: feat(macos): native-feel dashboard hosting — instant reopen, preload, frame autosave, ⌘N/⌘K, route memory

question: Should the macOS app proactively preload an authenticated Control UI after launch and persist native-host route state as default hybrid-shell behavior?
rationale: These additions change launch-time resource use and persisted navigation rather than only repairing an established contract, and the protected maintainer label calls for explicit product ownership.

options.title: Approve hybrid-shell defaults
options.body: Accept background preload and native-only route persistence after current-main refresh and convincing signed-app proof.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Retain instant reopen, frame autosave, shortcuts, menu filtering, and theming while deferring preload or route persistence.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep current launch and navigation behavior if proactive loading or persisted routes are not desired defaults.

recommendation.title: Approve hybrid-shell defaults
recommendation.body: Accept background preload and native-only route persistence after current-main refresh and convincing signed-app proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged history connects this person to both the macOS WebChat window and the Control UI architecture involved in this decision.
